  <methodName>execute_kw</methodName>

    <param><value><string>{{ $('Get credentials').item.json.database_name }}</string></value></param>

    <param><value><string>{{ $('Get credentials').item.json.password }}</string></value></param>
    <param><value><string>utm.campaign</string></value></param>
    <param><value><string>create</string></value></param>
    <param>
      <value>
        <array><data>
          <value>
            <struct>
              <member>
                <name>name</name>
                <value><string>{{ $('Get campaign').item.json.campaign_name }}</string></value>
              </member>
              <member>
                <name>user_id</name>
                <value><int>{{ $('Get credentials').item.json.UID }}</int></value>
              </member>

          </value>
        </data></array>
      </value>
    </param>
  </params>

=<?xml version="1.0"?>
<methodCall>
  <methodName>execute_kw</methodName>
  <params>

    <!-- 1. Authentication -->
    <param>
      <value><string>{{ $('Get credentials').item.json.database_name }}</string></value>
    </param>
    <param>
      <value><int>{{ $('Get credentials').item.json.UID }}</int></value>
    </param>
    <param>
      <value><string>{{ $('Get credentials').item.json.password }}</string></value>
    </param>

    <!-- 2. Target model -->
    <param>
      <value><string>mailing.mailing</string></value>
    </param>

    <!-- 3. Method -->
    <param>
      <value><string>create</string></value>
    </param>

    <!-- 4. Arguments -->
    <param>
      <value>
        <array>
          <data>
            <value>
              <struct>

                <!-- Basic fields -->
                <member>
                  <name>name</name>
                  <value><string>{{ $('Get Post ID').item.json.month +"_"+ $('Get Post ID').item.json.language }}</string></value>
                </member>

                <member>
                  <name>subject</name>
                  <value><string>{{ $('Get Post ID').item.json.email_subject.split(';')[0] }}</string></value>
                </member>

                <!-- Target model: Contacts -->
                <member>
                  <name>mailing_model_id</name>
                  <value><int>84</int></value>
                </member>

                <!-- Recipient filter (THIS IS THE IMPORTANT PART) -->
                <member>
                  <name>mailing_domain</name>
                  <value>
                    <string>{{ $('Create mailing filter').item.json.xml_filter }}</string>
                  </value>
                </member>

                <!-- Optional campaign -->
                <member>
                  <name>campaign_id</name>
                  <value><int>{{ $('Get campaign').item.json.campaign_odoo_id }}</int></value>
                </member>

                <!-- Sender -->
                <member>
                  <name>email_from</name>
                  <value><string>{{ $('Get Post ID').item.json.email_from }}</string></value>
                </member>

                <!-- Email type -->
                <member>
                  <name>mailing_type</name>
                  <value><string>mail</string></value>
                </member>

                <!-- Draft state -->
                <member>
                  <name>state</name>
                  <value><string>draft</string></value>
                </member>

                <!-- HTML body (full HTML, editor will be locked) -->
                <member>
                  <name>body_arch</name>
                  <value>
                    <string><![CDATA[
{{ $('Get Post ID').item.json.final_html }}
                    ]]></string>
                  </value>
                </member>

                <member>
                  <name>body_html</name>
                  <value>
                    <string><![CDATA[
{{ $('Get Post ID').item.json.final_html }}
                    ]]></string>
                  </value>
                </member>

              </struct>
            </value>
          </data>
        </array>
      </value>
    </param>

  </params>
</methodCall>
